Return the original label Entailment (supported), Contradiction (opposed), or NotMentioned (not settled by the document); do not substitute external law for contractual text. Decide the relation relative to the exact original hypothesis, including its negation, not whether the contract contains a prohibition. The same 17 hypotheses are checked on every document. All original text is present, with zero-based original span markers <SPAN i>...</SPAN i>. For supported/opposed hypotheses cite all original evidence span indices for that decision, including independently operative redundant support and necessary governing language. For NotMentioned return an empty evidence list. Treat conditions and exceptions within scope, and distinguish limited permission from universal permission. Give a short public reason (at most 15 words per hypothesis), then report supplied skill IDs actually used. Skills are fallible reusable inspection procedures, not facts about this NDA or automatic verdicts. All skills are visible together; public hypothesis IDs describe applicability, not hidden context isolation. Do not execute further tools, invent citations or rewrite span indices. Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. Evidence candidates are fallible, not mandatory citations; make every final label and evidence decision yourself from the complete original contract. Ordinary candidate original_span_index resolves to its exact quoted text in ordinary_candidate_original_text, shared once across questions. Scores and membership are fallible; empty candidates never imply NotMentioned. The complete CURRENT original contract and all original SPAN indices remain. The historical skills and full past-document demonstrations precede the CURRENT task. They are fallible reading assistance, not current facts or automatic verdicts. Its annotations are original training supervision, not claimed successful native trajectories. A past NM is interpretable only together with that full past source. Never transfer old parties, facts, labels or indices into the CURRENT contract. Read its entire source, follow definitions and conditions, and choose each original relation/evidence yourself. Missing a skill or familiar phrase is not proof of absence. Examples and sufficient clues are not exclusive necessary templates. All3 labels remain available; [] for used_skill_ids is legal.

<PAST H1:b>This Agreement made and entered into this 10th day of July, 1996 ("Effective Date"), by and between SHARP CORPORATION, a Japanese corporation, having its principal place of business at 22-22, Nagaike-cho, Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan (hereinafter called "Sharp") and Hybrid Networks, Inc., an American corporation, having its principal place of business at 10161 Bubb Road, Cupertino, California 95014-4167 (hereinafter called "Hybrid Networks").</PAST H1:b>
<PAST H1:c>WITNESSETH:</PAST H1:c>
<PAST H1:d>WHEREAS, Sharp and Hybrid Networks both have as their purpose an interest in exploring a possible business relationship and in order for the parties to explore this relationship, it may be necessary for the parties to disclose certain of their proprietary and other information to each other, which information each of the parties regards as confidential. </PAST H1:d><PAST H1:e>This confidential information relates to Cable Data Modem.</PAST H1:e>
<PAST H1:f>NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto agree as follows:</PAST H1:f>
<PAST H1:g>1. </PAST H1:g><PAST H1:h>(a) All of the confidential information (hereinafter "Confidential Information"), including, without limitation, all information relating to business plans, financial or technical matters, trade secrets, designs, know-how, inventions, operations and any other information received or acquired by one party ("Receiving Party") from the other ("Disclosing Party") in the course of exploring the possible business relationship shall be in written form and marked "Confidential," with the name of the Disclosing Party and the date of disclosure. </PAST H1:h><PAST H1:i>If the Confidential Information is initially disclosed orally, it shall be reduced to written form by the Disclosing Party (including the date of the oral disclosure and name of the Disclosing Party) and presented or mailed to the Receiving Party within fifteen (15) days of the first oral disclosure.</PAST H1:i>
<PAST H1:j>(b) The Confidential Information shall remain the property of the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1:j>
<PAST H1:k>(c) All information disclosed which is not marked "Confidential," or not reduced to written form and marked "Confidential" if initially disclosed orally shall be considered to be non-confidential and shall not be subject to the obligations imposed by this Agreement. </PAST H1:k><PAST H1:l>All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall be limited to the subject matter mentioned in the Recital. </PAST H1:l><PAST H1:m>The existence and terms of this Agreement shall be treated as Confidential Information.</PAST H1:m>
<PAST H1:n>2. The Receiving Party shall:</PAST H1:n>
<PAST H1:o>(a) hold the Confidential Information in confidence and not disclose it to third parties, except in the limited cases referred to in paragraph "6"; and</PAST H1:o>
<PAST H1:p>(b) not use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than exploring or examining the possibility of a business relationship between the parties.</PAST H1:p>
<PAST H1:q>3. Either party hereto shall have the right, at any time, to terminate in writing and discussions and exchange of information in connection with the exploration of the possibilities of a business relationship between the parties without any further obligations or liabilities to the other party, other than the obligations of confidentiality hereunder, or any right or obligation relating to the Confidential Information hereunder.</PAST H1:q>
<PAST H1:r>4.</PAST H1:r><PAST H1:s>(i) The obligations of the above paragraph "2" shall not apply to any information which:</PAST H1:s>
<PAST H1:t>(a) is available to the public through no breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1:t>
<PAST H1:u>(b) was in the possession of the Receiving Party prior to receipt from the Disclosing Party; or</PAST H1:u>
<PAST H1:v>(c) is received independently from a third party who is free to disclose such information to the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1:v>
<PAST H1:w>(d) is subsequently independently developed by the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1:w>
<PAST H1:x>(e) has been or is made public by the Disclosing Party, such as by commercial use or sale or by publications or patents, or otherwise; or</PAST H1:x>
<PAST H1:y>(f) is approved for release by written consent of the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1:y>
<PAST H1:z>(ii) Disclosure of Confidential </PAST H1:z><PAST H1:aa>Information shall not be precluded if such disclosure is pursuant to the requirement or request of a governmental agency or by operation of law. </PAST H1:aa><PAST H1:ab>Provided, however, the Receiving Party shall promptly give a written notice to the Disclosing party so that the Disclosing Party may seek an appropriate protective order.</PAST H1:ab>
<PAST H1:ac>5. All Confidential Information delivered to and/or in the possession of the Receiving Party shall be returned or delivered to the Disclosing Party, with all copies made thereof, in whatever form, if the Disclosing Party so requests.</PAST H1:ac>
<PAST H1:ad>6. The Receiving Party agrees that the Confidential Information shall be disclosed to only those people within its respective organizations or its agents, consultants, representatives or advisors who have a need to know the information and who are obligated under terms no less restrictive than those imposed by this Agreement on the Receiving Party.</PAST H1:ad>
<PAST H1:ae>7. Each party shall have the right to refuse to accept any information under this Agreement, and nothing herein shall obligate either party to disclose to the other party any particular information. </PAST H1:ae><PAST H1:af>Further, each party acknowledges that no contract or agreement providing for a business relationship, of any nature, shall be deemed to exist unless and until a final definitive agreement has been executed and delivered.</PAST H1:af>
<PAST H1:ag>8. If any official approval is required by a government authority or disclose the Confidential Information hereunder, such disclosure is subject to that approval. </PAST H1:ag><PAST H1:ah>Both parties shall comply in all respects with applicable laws, regulations and court orders, including but not limited to laws and regulations on export control, in both parties' countries and other applicable countries.</PAST H1:ah>
<PAST H1:ai>9. Disclosure of any information under this Agreement, or otherwise, shall not be construed as granting, directly or by implication, any license under or interest of any kind in any patent, patent application, copyright or other intellectual property rights.</PAST H1:ai>
<PAST H1:aj>10. The Disclosing Party represents and warrants that it has the right to disclose the information disclosed under the terms of this Agreement and that disclosure of this information does not conflict with the terms of any agreement between the Disclosing Party and a third party.</PAST H1:aj>
<PAST H1:ak>11. The parties hereto shall not be obligated to compensate each other for the disclosure and/or use pursuant to the terms of this Agreement of any information exchanged in connection with this Agreement or the discussions between the parties.</PAST H1:ak>
<PAST H1:al>12. This Agreement supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, representations and statements, whether oral or written, between the parties relating to the disclosure of the Confidential Information. </PAST H1:al><PAST H1:am>The terms of this Agreement may not be changed except by subsequent written agreement duly signed by an officer of each of the parties.</PAST H1:am>
<PAST H1:an>13. Subject to Paragraph </PAST H1:an><PAST H1:ao>"4" hereof, the obligation of the Receiving Party provided in Paragraph "2" hereof shall continue for three (3) years from the date of each receipt of the Confidential Information, even after termination of this Agreement according to paragraph "3" hereof.</PAST H1:ao>
<PAST H1:ap>14. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Japan.</PAST H1:ap>
<PAST H1:aq>15. The Receiving Party acknowledges that remedies of damages may be inadequate to protect against breach of this Agreement and the Receiving Party agrees in advance to the granting of injunctive or other equitable relief to the Disclosing Party in addition to any other remedy which may be available to the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1:aq>
<PAST H1:ar>16. The Disclosing Party does not make any representation or warranty, except as may be specifically provided in writing, as to the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information, or as to its utility or suitability for any purpose of the Receiving Party and the Disclosing Party expressly disclaims any right of the Receiving Party to rely thereon, or any liability to the Receiving Party resulting from the use of the Confidential Information.</PAST H1:ar>
<PAST H1:as>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties by their duly authorized representatives have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date first set forth above.</PAST H1:as>

<SPAN 1>NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT /</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>CONDUCT POLICY</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>Recipient agrees that all information disclosed by the Company to Recipient, including without limitation information acquired by Recipient from Company employees or inspection of the Company’s property, relating to (without limitation) the Company’s products, designs, business plans, business opportunities, finances, research, development, know-how or personnel, and confidential information disclosed to the Company by third parties, shall be considered Confidential Information. </SPAN 3><SPAN 4>Recipient agrees to maintain the confidence of the Confidential Information and to prevent its unauthorized dissemination; provided however, that Confidential Information shall not include information which </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>(i) is now or subsequently becomes generally known or available by publication, commercial use or otherwise, through no fault of Recipient, </SPAN 5><SPAN 6>(ii) is known by Recipient at the time of disclosure, </SPAN 6><SPAN 7>(iii) is independently developed by Recipient without the use of any Confidential Information, </SPAN 7><SPAN 8>(iv) is lawfully obtained by Recipient from a third party without violation of a confidentiality obligation, or </SPAN 8><SPAN 9>(v) the Company agrees in writing may be disclosed by Recipient.</SPAN 9>
<SPAN 10>Recipient expressly agrees not to use the Confidential Information for purposes other than those necessary to consider the possibility of entering into a business relationship with the Company.</SPAN 10>
<SPAN 11>All Confidential Information remains the property of the Company and no license or other rights in the Confidential Information is granted hereby. </SPAN 11><SPAN 12>All information is provided “as is” and without any warranty, express, implied, or otherwise, regarding its accuracy or performance. </SPAN 12><SPAN 13>Recipient agrees to return to the Company immediately upon the Company’s written request all Confidential Information, including but not limited to all computer programs, documentation, notes, plans, drawings, and copies thereof. </SPAN 13><SPAN 14>Recipient agrees to comply with all United States export controls with respect to the Confidential Information.</SPAN 14>
<SPAN 15>Recipient hereby acknowledges that unauthorized disclosure or use of Confidential Information could cause irreparable harm and significant injury which may be difficult to ascertain. </SPAN 15><SPAN 16>Accordingly, Recipient agrees that the Company shall have the right to seek and obtain immediate injunctive relief from breaches of this Agreement, in addition to any other rights and remedies it may have.</SPAN 16>
<SPAN 17>This Agreement shall be governed by and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of California as they apply to contracts entered into and wholly to be performed in the State of California. </SPAN 17><SPAN 18>The federal and state courts within the State of California shall have exclusive jurisdiction to adjudicate any dispute arising out of this Agreement.</SPAN 18>
<SPAN 19>Prior to taking YOUR exam, you will be required to accept the terms and conditions of the VMware NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (NDA). </SPAN 19><SPAN 20>You will view the agreement on screen before the exam starts. </SPAN 20><SPAN 21>If you choose NOT to agree to the NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (NDA) after you select Begin Exam, your exam will be immediately cancelled and you will forfeit your exam fee.</SPAN 21>
<SPAN 22>BY CLICKING THE “YES, I AGREE” BUTTON ON THE EXAM ENTRY SCREEN, YOU STATE THAT YOU HAVE READ AND UNDERSTAND THIS AGREEMENT AND THAT YOU AGREE TO BE BOUND BY ITS TERMS AND CONDITIONS. </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>IF YOU SELECT THE "NO, I DO NOT AGREE" BUTTON, YOU WILL BE EXITED FROM THE EXAM.</SPAN 23>

guidance.inspection: Reconstruct the complete operative protected-information definition, including incorporated definitions, preambles, alternatives, exclusions, and form conditions. For explicit identification, test the universal requirement: reasonable-understanding, nature, circumstances, or automatic-inclusion alternatives contradict it; silence is NotMentioned. Express nontechnical subjects contradict technical-only scope. Express oral or verbal inclusion entails verbal coverage even if confirmation is required. Preserve every independently responsive definition and alternative.

Locate an operative permission, exclusion, restriction, or reservation and verify actor, object, recipient class, purpose, polarity, and conditions. Keep independent development distinct from lawful third-party receipt. Sharing needs an operative disclosure or access rule plus incorporated class definitions; an exclusive employee-only rule contradicts nonemployee sharing. Limited use requires a use restriction, not purpose-limited copying or disclosure. No-licensing requires an express no-right, ownership, or reservation rule; access alone is unresolved.

Read each return, destruction, copying, retention, and survival clause with its trigger, lead-in, alternatives, exceptions, and cross-references. Return-or-destruction needs a mandatory disposition tied within the operative rule to termination or a comparable contractual end; a request-only duty remains NotMentioned. Copy permission must be affirmative; consent-dependent prohibition contradicts it. Post-disposition possession requires an express retention exception, while an unqualified all-material duty contradicts it. Survival requires an identified obligation continuing after an end event.

Inspect the complete document for four separate controls. Agreement confidentiality includes nondisclosure of the agreement, its existence or terms, or discussions or negotiations; a direct sentence is sufficient, while definition-based coverage also needs the secrecy duty. Compelled-disclosure notice needs legal or governmental compulsion linked to notice or consultation. Preserve all operative personnel and corpus-supervised proxy-solicitation restrictions with lead-ins and exceptions. Reverse engineering requires an operative reverse-engineering, decompilation, or disassembly prohibition; absence of a clause is only NotMentioned.
